text.en:
The Metro Manila Inter Agency Committee on Informal
Settiers. The Metro Manila Inter-Agency Committee (MMIAC) on Informal Settlers is
hereby created, composed of the Metropolitan Mania Development Authority (MMDA) as
chair, and the National Housing Authority (NHA) as vice chair, with the foliowing members
the Housing and Urban Deveiopment Coordinating Council (HUDOC; the Presidential
Commission for the Urban Poor (PCUP); the National Anti-Foverty Commission (NAPC); the
Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWHY the Department of the Interior and
Local Government (DILG) the Office of the President - Extemal Affairs (OPEA), the
Department of Budget and Management (DBM); and a representative from the urban. poor
as identified by the MIAC
The MMLAC wall invite te Commission on Human Rights (CHR) and other soco-
civic organizations and associations to become mebers of the Committee,
The concened local government unit (LGU) shall be invited and entitled to a vote
whenever the matter is within its jurisdiction,

Assistance from Government Agencies. All goverment agencies
are directed to actively cooperate and support the MMIAC. in tas regard, MMIAC may call
upon any agency of the goverment for assistance and coupetation, including, but not
limited to, seeking the necessary technical services and support to the implementation of a
Comprehensive Shelter Program (SP), such as the provision of basic community facilities;
including logistics and the conduct of continuing training and development with emphasis
on livelihood anal educational programs in collaboration with the private sector, religious
organizations and partiopating NGOs,

Lead Agencies. The MMDA and the NHA are the lead agencies in
the implementation of a CSP for informal settlers within Metro Manila, such as those
affected by government Infrastructure projects, and those thing in, near or along danger
areas such as riverbanks, esteros, roadways, sidewaiks, agueducts, bridges, railroad tracks,
garbage dumps, shorelines and waterways,

Functions of the MMIAC. The MMIAC sall have the following
major functions
a. Develop a CSP for qualified informal settlers affected by goveranent priority
infrastructure projects and those living in danger areas.
b. Provide molicy directons and guidelines for the smooth and effective
implementation of the CSP.
c. Seek funds and logistical support and resources from participating agencies and
other concerned entities and the private sector for the effective and efficient
implementation of the CSP

d. Enter into a memorandum of agreement or other local institutional arrangement
with and among concerned national and local government agencies, non-
government organizations and private entities for the speedy implementation of
e. Exercise oversight functions on the implementation of the specific components of
f. Peronn such other functions as may be assigned by the President.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. The MMIAC shall
promulgate its Implementing Rules and Regulations to implement the SP as well as
provisions of this Executive Order.

Funding. The MMIAC, through MMDA, is hereby directed to set up a
trust fund in accordance with law, wherein funds sourced from the Office of the President,
National Government Agencies, LGUs (counterpart funds), Beneficiary Agencies and other
participating organizations (NGOs and private sector) can be drawn from, subject to
accounting and auditing rules and regulations, to expedite the implementation of the SP
as well as the other housing strategies and policies developed by the MMIAC.

Repeal. All executive orders, rules and regulations and other
issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are hereby
revoked, amended, or modified accordingly.

Separability. Any portion or provision of this Executive Order that
maybe declared unconstitutional shall not have the effect of nullifying its other portions or
provisions, as long as such remaining portions can still be given effect.

Effectivity.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediatoly
following its publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 2157 day of MAY
